measurement_limits: Three-seed fixed-work synthetic diagnostics; not whole-solver, quality or C++ evidence.
Profile fractions are biased diagnostics, not unprofiled time shares or Amdahl headroom.
Search timing excludes construction and startup; full-profile totals include runner setup.
Dimension shards used different CPU models; no controlled cross-dimension timing claim.
Large-dimension GRASP can stop during its first construction; completed stages are unavailable.
Raw shards and host observations are available in run artifacts with 90-day retention.
